name: Soulbrain Co., Ltd.
summary: Soulbrain Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and supplies various high tech industry core materials. It provides semiconductor materials, including CVD/ALD materials, etchant and cleaning agents, CMP slurries, and plating agents, as well as hydrofluoric acid/buffered oxide etchants for etching and cleaning of semiconductor oxide films. The company also offers functional chemical materials used in the manufacture of LCD and OLED panels, as well as components of panels, including thin glass and cell scribings.
